notes.title: Patch v1.0.1: Now Easier to Quit on Steam Deck – Plus a Bug Fix
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for playing [i]Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+[/i]![/p][p]In this update we have added improvements for the users on Steam Deck to be able to exit the game easier! We also fixed the Steam achievements bug as well![/p][p][/p][p]·       You can now press the “View” button on the Steam Deck at the Title Screen to bring up the option to exit the game[/p][p]·       You can now press the B-button at the Home Screen to go back to the Title Screen on the Steam Deck[/p][p]·       Fixed a bug where the final achievement in Steam would not unlock under certain conditions[/p][p][/p][p]We thank the users for their valuable feedback![/p][p]Hope you continue to enjoy the game!
[/p]

·       You can now press the B-button at the Home Screen to go back to the Title Screen on the Steam Deck

notes.title: “Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+” Just Got Steam Community Items!
notes.content:
To everyone who's been playing Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+ — thank you so much!
We wanted to make your experience even more fun, so we’ve released a set of Steam Community Items! ✨🎉

After playing the game, why not deck out your Steam profile with Miku and the rest of the Piapro characters?

🎁Here’s what’s waiting for you:
[list]
[*] Badges
[*] Emoctions
[*] Logos
[*] Profile Backgrounds
[*] Trading Cards (Small & Large)
[/list]Thanks again for all your support!
Let’s keep enjoying Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+ together!🎮💚

tags.feature: - A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin

notes.title: Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+ Coming July 24th + Giveaway
notes.content:
Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+ is landing on Steam July 24th, and to celebrate we are hosting a Hatsune Miku Figurine Giveaway! Wishlist today and enter to win!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693931/f4e6b17e8d274fcc288f0018c1cb8312fc1ae0d1.png[/img]

The official sequel to the 2020 original game, Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+ features the vocaloid sensation and includes hours of relaxed, but challenging nonogram puzzling, adventuring and more!

[h2]Enter to Win[/h2]

To celebrate the upcoming launch, we’re hosting an exciting giveaway featuring some truly special Hatsune Miku prizes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693931/4147f7ea385476459bc821161520825b08497007.jpg[/img]

3 lucky winners will take home a stunning 1/7th scale “Beauty Looking Back” Hatsune Miku figure, plus an exclusive Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+ themed acrylic block.

And that’s not all — 10 additional winners will receive the exclusive acrylic block as a Second Prize!

Entering is easy: just visit our giveaway page and follow the steps to boost your chances of winning. Don’t miss this opportunity to own these limited-edition collectibles!

https://plaza-us.komodo.jp/pages/hatsune-miku-logic-paint-s-launch-giveaway

Don’t miss your chance — enter by July 31st and check the Terms and Conditions to confirm your eligibility.

[h2]Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+: Wishlist Today[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693931/1c991f5d7114fb5e2a98568e3351dd32a996921c.jpg[/img]

Solve over 1000+ puzzles (nearly 3 times as many as the original) while Hatsune Miku, or one of your other favorite Piapro Characters, cheers you along! Solving puzzles unlocks illustrations, songs, and all new in Logic Paint S+ collect costumes to dress up Hatsune Miku and friends, and decorations to fill out a fun room for them to hang out in!
